children: Threat Assessment and Arlo Summary Provide Greater Insight and Proactive Protection, Strengthening Arlo Secure Early Warning System's Comprehensive Capabilities
CARLSBAD, Calif., Sept. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --

), a leading provider of smart home security services, today announced Arlo Secure 7, the latest evolution of its AI-powered smart security service. Arlo Secure 7 introduces two new AI-powered features – Threat Assessment and Arlo Summary – alongside user experience improvements and a new 24/7 video recording plan. Together with the Arlo Secure Early Warning System's existing AI-powered detection and intelligence capabilities, these updates give users greater context, awareness and control over their home security.

Arlo Summary provides an easy-to-understand recap of important activity from the past 24 hours, while Threat Assessment identifies urgent, high-risk situations — such as break-ins, fire, armed threats, or theft— and automatically initiates the appropriate response based on the event. From active deterrence by turning on the camera's siren or spotlight, to autonomously contacting a live Safety Agent, Threat Assessment ensures action within seconds.

"We saw an industry-wide need for sharper insights, faster awareness, and proactive escalation to reduce response time when consumers need it most," said Matthew McRae, Chief Executive Officer at Arlo. "With the addition of Threat Assessment, the Arlo Secure Early Warning System is more intuitive and actionable than ever before, delivering a smarter, safer home security experience for the millions who rely on Arlo for protection."
New Arlo Secure 7 Features
The following new features will roll out to Arlo Secure Early Warning System customers over the next month:
Threat Assessment

Threat Assessment introduces industry-leading intelligence to identify events that have a potential threat versus everyday activity and transforms Arlo cameras into a system that takes proactive action. Based on the severity of the event, Arlo automatically triggers a response matched to the threat, alerting the user immediately and, when appropriate, escalating to a professional monitoring center for emergency dispatch. Real-time updates keep users informed as the situation unfolds, with critical push notifications that will break through Mute and do-not-disturb settings to ensure the appropriate level of attention.
Arlo Summary:

Available on demand, Arlo Summary generates a short recap of video recordings from the last 24 hours. It filters out routine or insignificant events and delivers a plain-language story at the top of the Arlo Feed so users can quickly catch up on what matters most without watching every clip.
New Arlo Ultra Secure Plan with 24/7 Recording

With this latest release, Arlo also introduces a new plan option for consumers and small businesses seeking continuous video recording capabilities. The Arlo Ultra Secure Plan delivers 24/7 recording for up to three cameras (support for unlimited cameras coming soon), with recordings kept for 30 days.

Three Arlo Secure Early Warning System plans are available now — Smart Aware, Smart Secure, and Ultra Secure. A one-month trial of Arlo Secure is included with the purchase of select Arlo products. After the trial, premium features require a paid subscription.
Key Benefits of Arlo Secure Early Warning System
Arlo cameras capture the moments that matter, and the Arlo Secure Early Warning System helps make sense of them. With an Arlo Secure Early Warning System plan, you can:
Know who's there and who shouldn't be:
Get alerts when a person, vehicle, animal or package is detected with smart motion detection.
Know it's your family, not a threat

Know exactly who's on your property with alerts identifying names of familiar faces and familiar vehicles. Feel safer knowing family and friends have arrived home safely, or take action when strangers approach your front door.
Keep an eye on important deliveries:
Receive alerts when your Arlo camera or doorbell sees a package being picked up or dropped off.
Spot danger before it spreads
Lifesaving, AI-powered notifications alert you when a flame is detected, so you can prevent the spread of fire.
Listen for critical sounds:
Receive notifications that tell you when a scream, gunshot, bark, glass break, or Smoke/CO alarm is detected, so you can take action in real time.
Create personalized alerts:
Create custom, real-time detections for things that matter to you, like when the garage door is left open.
Quickly understand what's happening:
Read concise, accurate event captions of your camera's footage for an at-a-glance description of the clip.
Locate and review critical moments:
Quickly locate and review critical moments in your video history by searching for specific keywords, descriptions, or time ranges, eliminating the need to manually sift through your video library.

About Arlo Technologies, Inc.

Arlo is an award-winning industry leader that is transforming the ways in which people can protect everything that matters to them with advanced home, business, and personal security solutions. Arlo's deep expertise in AI- and CV-powered analytics, cloud services, user experience and product design, and innovative wireless and RF connectivity enables the delivery of a seamless, smart security experience for Arlo users that is easy to set up and interact with every day. Arlo's cloud-based platform provides users with visibility, insight, and a powerful means to help protect and connect in real-time with the people and things that matter most, from any location with a Wi-Fi or a cellular connection. Arlo has recently launched several categories of award-winning connected devices, software, and services. These include wire-free, smart Wi-Fi and LTE-enabled security cameras, video doorbells, floodlights, security system, and Arlo's subscription service, Arlo Secure.

With a mission to bring users peace of mind, Arlo is as passionate about protecting user privacy as it is about safeguarding homes and families. Arlo is committed to implementing industry standards for data protection designed to keep users' personal information private and in their control. Arlo provides enhanced controls for user data, supports privacy legislation, keeps user data safely secure, and puts security at the forefront of company culture.
